---
title: "Curriculum Vitæ"
format:
  html: default
  pdf:
    filters:
      - cv/styles.lua
    keep-tex: true
    template: cv/template.tex
cvauthor: Adriano Rutz
cvprofession: Pharmaceutical Scientist
cvcolor: 58748F
# Contact details, one field per value.
#
# These used to be sentences jammed into the `right` slot of cvmeta — the phone
# and email sat on the Field row and the address on the Languages row, because
# that was the only free-text field available. It meant every consumer had to
# read them back out of a sentence, and on the web it meant a postal address was
# announced as a language.
#
# `website` and `phone` are printed in the PDF only. The website
# page shows the email and the town: a link to this site from this site carries
# no information, and a phone number on a public page is only a thing to be
# collected.
cvcontact:
  email: adriano.rutz@ik.me
  website: https://adafede.github.io
  phone: "+41 76 521 45 40"
  location: Zürich, Switzerland

  # The header strip: one statement each, with no trailing detail to parse.
  #
  # Named the way a CV names them. "Status" and "Field" say almost nothing to a
  # reader scanning for a position or for research areas, and the labels are also
  # what the structured data on the page is keyed off, so the standard terms are
  # what let these facts be published as schema.org properties instead of free
  # text.
cvmeta:
  - title: Current position
    left: Postdoctoral Researcher, ETH Zürich
  - title: Areas of expertise
    left: Mass Spectrometry, Metabolomics, Natural Products, Open Science
  - title: Languages
    left: French (C2), English (C1), German (C1), Italian (C1)
